mentions.name: Checkra
mentions.description: Checkra is an inline assistant that provides UX, copy, and conversion feedback directly on a website. It installs with a tiny JS snippet, is free to use without an account, and helps generate A/B versions of pages and copy to streamline product development workflows.
mentions.source_excerpt: Checkra, an inline assistant for UX, copy and conversion feedback right on your site. It’s easy to set up with a tiny JS snippet and free to use - no account needed. We’re using it for our in-house product development and it has streamlined our workflow for generating A/B versions of pages and copy significantly
